name: RustberryPi maintenance
description: Select one job or all jobs for a shared maintenance window. Requires a mounted NAS backup destination.

spec.question_description: All runs OS, pinned FEX, then Rust with one countdown and backup.
600 gives ten minutes. Zero still announces immediately before saving and stopping.

spec.question_name: FEX commit (required for fex or all)
spec.question_description: Exact 40-character commit, reviewed before launch; never automatic latest.

spec.question_name: FEX version (required for fex or all)
spec.question_description: Version label matching the selected commit. Also persist both desired pins in private host vars.
